content:
sylvia: heads up — release v3.8.0 cut is blocked, CI failing on packaging step

matt: which job? link?

sylvia: buildkite #473 on linux-wheels. error fetching private wheel from pypi-proxy (504 timeout). logs below:
```
ERROR: Could not fetch https://pypi.internal.redwood/wheels/redwood_core-1.2.3.whl (504)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  ...
requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 504 Gateway Timeout
```

carla: @matt @kai what are options — retry, pin to last-green, or skip wheels and use source install? release window is 2h

matt: retrying buildkite job now. but if proxy is flaky we should avoid repeated retries. last-green uses redwood_core-1.2.2 which passed earlier today

ci-bot: buildkite job 473 retriggered by matt at 2026-03-20T15:18:12Z :arrow_up_small:

kai: quick note — the pypi proxy has had elevated latencies since the cache purge yesterday. ops has a mitigation but may take 30m. we can either pin to 1.2.2 for cut, or produce a wheel artifact in CI and upload to the release bucket and have installers read that artifact instead of pypi

sylvia: pin sounds fastest. downside: slight delta from last commit, but patch is tiny (docs + typing). also need release notes to reflect pinned dep

carla: agree pin for now. can we do an interim promote workflow: create a release candidate with 1.2.2 then follow up with a post-cut patch to re-upgrade when proxy stable?

matt: yep. steps: 1) update constraints.txt to redwood_core==1.2.2 in release branch 2) run buildkite -> confirm wheels built 3) promote artifact. I'll open a tiny PR and mark as release-pin

deploy-bot: promotion blocked until CI succeeds on canary. Current status: canary failed (job 475) — see logs. :warning:

matt: canary failure is same proxy timeout during pip install. I changed pip to --no-cache-dir for deterministic fetch, but proxy still times out. will switch to installing from our release-bucket wheel after PR lands

carla: @sylvia i want you to own the release note change for the pin and call out rollback plan (re-upgrade step) so support can triage if customers ask

sylvia: on it. will add a short note in the release-docs and the #customer-notices draft.

kai: ops update: rolling restart of pypi-proxy underway, ETA ~20m. but agree with pin+artifact plan as more robust long-term

matt: PR out: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/commit/abc123 pinned redwood_core==1.2.2, CI triggered

ci-bot: buildkite job 481 started (release-branch)

matt: job 481 passed. preparing promote.

deploy-bot: promotion performed to canary at 2026-03-20T15:35:20Z. Canary tests green. :white_check_mark:

carla: cutting release v3.8.0-rc1 with pinned dep. follow-up task to bump to 1.2.3 once proxy stable: OPS-1427.

sylvia: tagging release and updating notes now. thanks team. :tada:
